notes.title: Tales of Isenberg: Bertha's Journey – NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531331/8ef812e1891042ebdbc31734545764eb2c065fc1.png"][/img][/p][p]With the latest update, Bertha's Journey, the game’s first official expansion, is now available! [/p][p]Key features: 
-Brand-new campaign with approximately half an hour of gameplay 
-Split-screen mode available in both the base game and the expansion 
-Unlockable extras, a mini-game, and new achievements 
-Story expansion featuring previously unseen characters 
-New music tracks fitting the adventure’s atmosphere 
-Customizable keybindings 
-German subtitles 
-Numerous minor improvements and bug fixes for a better gameplay experience[/p]
